source: Original ATR4.1 executed offline in Atari8007.2.1; full indexed raster per VBI, original register audio; no video-reference frames or CPU runtime.
limits: Station ends at the first original $1DF5 cycle boundary; asynchronous loader poll alone is suppressed after ship assets are resident.
Launch capture ends immediately before first $3EBA; selected-level captions use original numeric glyph bases.
Raster data is PAL; NTSC playback uses its VBI rate but a separate continuous NTSC capture has not been verified.
POKEY states are sampled once per displayed original frame; sub-frame analogue phase is not represented.
